bio_en: Khachatur Manukian, known as Darbin ('smith') and Kheco, was born in 1880 in Herher in Vayots Dzor and was already an ARF member when he was conscripted in 1900. Returning before the Armenian-Tatar clashes, he served as guide and interpreter to the Cossack company hunting the ARF bands, secretly warning the party and leading the Cossacks on false trails, so that the bands escaped pursuit. In spring 1920 he joined the force attacking Chiva and fought beside his company commander to the end of the campaign. In January 1924, while on duty in harsh weather, he fell ill and died of pneumonia on 6 February 1924.
